title: Close call with MPs on the train; Eckstine orders the pot thrown out
summary: Two players hide their stash while military police sit nearby, and Eckstine makes everyone throw theirs from the windows.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: When we left El Paso, we had a whole coach to ourselves. Because apparently, there wasn't nobody traveling to California that much then. So we got on, and it was very comfortable. We got something like a two days ride, I believe it was, or a two-and-a-half days ride to California from El

Paso. So, as we're riding, we get comfortable after a while. One of the guys, a couple of the guys who had bought one of these pounds, went in the men's room in this coach, took in there -- they were going to clean it, you know. Because we got two days to kill, and we didn't know what to do...

When they went in there, they went in to clean it, and you had the little sitting vestibule and then you have the regular toilet. And they were in the toilet together, cleaning this thing. At that particular time, the MPs and SPs were patrolling trains, looking for guys AWOL from the Army and the Navy, etcetera. So they had two guys on there that were up and down, walking through the train all the time. It so happens that they came by and took a seat where these toilets were. And while they were sitting there, these two band members are inside of the thing. So it's not customary for two men to go in the toilet together. You know, women do it sometimes, but it isn't a thing that men do, as a rule.

So these guys, when they're getting ready to come out, they see the SP and the MP sitting out there. And all of us thought that if they had been smart, they would have just walked past, but in a thing like that, you panic. What they did was close the door again, and took this stuff and put it behind the stool in the toilet, came out and sat back down. So after a while, the MP and the SP left, and they went back
to get the stuff, and it wasn't there. We said, "Uh-oh, this is the second incident that's happened."

So Billy Eckstine told all the guys, told everybody, "Look, if any of you all have anything, take it and throw it away right now. Throw it out of the window." Because we were riding coach, and at that particular time you could open the window on a train. He said, "If you've got, just take it and throw it away." It broke everybody's heart. The guys had to throw a pound-and-a-half of some of the best pot in the world, down from Texas and Mexico you know... Had to just throw it away, throw it out there in the desert. And the guys were saying, "Man, maybe..." "No, no, just throw it away. I'm telling you!" And that's what they did.
